mechanism_chain.content: Vast/complex stimuli exceed brain's current generative model; the prediction error IS the need for accommodation (Keltner & Haidt 2003 theoretical framework). Van Elk et al 2019 N=32 VR-induced awe via virtual cathedral: increased skin conductance d=0.55 for DMN suppression. Yaden et al 2019 systematic review identifies DMN suppression + anterior insula activation.

mechanism_chain.content: Salience network detects the vast stimulus as behaviourally significant; anterior insula activation (interoceptive surprise per Barrett-Craig Stage 2); dACC engagement signals prediction error to higher cortical areas. Converges with SALIENCE_NETWORK_SWITCH_001 (Template 9).

mechanism_chain.content: Brain attempts to accommodate the vast stimulus by revising its generative model; this IS what Keltner calls 'need for accommodation' described in PP terms. When accommodation succeeds: awe + understanding. When accommodation fails: overwhelm or sublimity (Kant's mathematical sublime).

description: Awe mechanism: architectural vastness, high PE, schema revision, and awe experience
tier_a_justification: Awe is a contested construct with multiple theoretical accounts (Keltner & Haidt emotional taxonomy, Friston PP/free-energy, Yaden self-transcendent experiences). The PE-accommodation-SN mechanism is the panel's synthesis but not the only viable account.

competing_accounts.description: Awe is a basic emotion with innate trigger features (Ekman lineage)
Awe is a form of mystical experience reducing self-boundaries (Yaden & Newberg 2015)
Awe is a culturally-constructed category applied to high-arousal, low-control experiences (Barrett 2017)

name: Awe Mechanism

cross_template_interactions.description: Vast/complex stimuli exceed dose-response optimal range, triggering high-PE awe response. Awe occurs at extreme high end of environmental complexity/vastness dose-response curve (baseline + 100-200%).
Vast stimulus activates salience network for high-PE detection; anterior insula elevation during awe reflects SN response to prediction error magnitude. SN switching mediates awe experience onset.

Thalamic gating channels multimodal vastness cues (visual, auditory, proprioceptive) that collectively exceed model capacity. Thalamic pre-filtering combines information streams before awe-PE emergence.
Architectural hierarchy (room-building-landscape) determines vastness PE magnitude: building-level or landscape-level hierarchy violations produce stronger awe than room-level violations.
Awe mechanism produces the prediction error and salience amplification that triggers small-self downstream. Small-self is the interoceptive consequence of awe's DMN suppression.

Cultural background determines awe trigger type and intensity: collectivist cultures show awe to authority-connected vastness; individualist cultures show awe to natural vastness. Same mechanism, different trigger.

higher_order_principle: Architectural vastness → awe experience pathway: The mechanism by which awe mechanism operates
